lessons.title: Week 9 Part 1: Connection Before Correction in Everyday Moments
lessons.content: In Week 9 of Core Trauma-Informed Parenting Skills, this lesson focuses on connection before correction in everyday moments. Parents and carers practise pausing to notice stress cues, responding with calm and predictable language, maintaining child-safe boundaries, and recording one observable example of how this skill supported their child's safety and emotional wellbeing this week.
